  "tokenized_directions": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "COOK THE {{ing_01|CHICKEN}} [as follows, in] {{ing_02|BROTH}}, {{ing_03|OIL}}, WITH {{ing_04|WINE}} ADDED, TO WHICH ADD {{ing_05|A BUNCH OF CORIANDER}} AND {{ing_06|GREEN ONIONS}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "WHEN DONE TAKE IT OUT [3] [strain and save] THE {{ing_02|BROTH}}, AND PUT IT IN A NEW SAUCE PAN, ADD {{ing_07|MILK}} AND {{ing_08|A LITTLE SALT}}, {{ing_09|HONEY}} AND {{ing_10|A PINT [4] OF WATER, THAT IS, A THIRD PART}}: PLACE IT BACK ON A SLOW FIRE TO SIMMER."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "FINALLY BREAK {{ing_11|[the paste, [1]]}} PUT IT LITTLE BY LITTLE INTO {{ing_02|[the boiling broth]}} STIRRING WELL SO IT WILL NOT BURN."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "PUT THE {{ing_01|CHICKEN}} IN, EITHER WHOLE OR IN PIECES [5] DISH IT OUT IN A DEEP DISH."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "text": "THIS COVER WITH THE FOLLOWING SAUCE [6] {{ing_12|PEPPER}}, {{ing_13|LOVAGE}}, {{ing_14|ORIGANY}}, MOISTENED WITH {{ing_09|HONEY}} AND {{ing_15|A LITTLE REDUCED MUST}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 6,
      "text": "ADD SOME OF THE {{ing_16|[chicken] BROTH}}, HEAT IN A SMALL SAUCE PAN AND WHEN IT BOILS THICKEN WITH {{ing_17|ROUX [7]}} AND SERVE."
    }
  ],
